name: numeric-float-spelling-converges
description: A start_year given in float form (1e15) canonicalises to the same bytes and mints the same id as the identical value spelled as a 16-character plain integer literal. Paired with numeric-integer-spelling-converges.
notes: Deliberately shares its spec_id with numeric-integer-spelling-converges.json -- both spellings evaluate to the identical IEEE-754 double and JCS serialises that double identically regardless of how the source literal was spelled, so the two vectors converge on one id rather than colliding by accident (mirrors the facets-explicit-empty-object-converges/facets-omitted-member-converges precedent). The value 1e15 (1000000000000000) is not a calendar-year claim, only a magnitude chosen safely below 2^53-1 -- mirrors numeric-negative-zero's stance on its own domain-odd value.
